<div class="section-intro">
Projects is the development layer of this website: active or planned research that is not yet represented by a formal publication. Private manuscript repositories can be described here without exposing their source repository.
</div>

::: {.qs-footnote-note}
**Project model.** `type-paper` is reserved for one defined manuscript. `type-project` is for a broader or exploratory initiative that is not yet committed to one manuscript. Project cards use a repository logo when a web-safe mirrored asset is available; otherwise they use a neutral project mark until the repository receives `logo.svg` or `logo.png`.
:::
